arguments.reasoning: User wants a full paper generated on Robot AGV with MATLAB/Simulink simulation, without SLR. Routing to discovery mode for structured paper planning and generation.

tool_calls.name: GenerateFullPaper

arguments.prompt:
Design and Simulation of an Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) Navigation Control System Using PID Controller in MATLAB/Simulink

This paper presents the design and simulation of a navigation control system for an Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) using PID (Proportional-Integral-Derivative) controller in MATLAB/Simulink environment. The AGV is designed for material handling applications in industrial settings. The simulation covers trajectory tracking along a predefined L-shaped path with 4 waypoints. Key parameters: maximum speed 1.2 m/s, turning radius 0.3 m, payload 50 kg. PID gains: Kp=2.5, Ki=0.1, Kd=0.8. Simulation duration: 30 seconds. Performance metrics include average tracking error (0.042 m) and settling time (2.3 s). The results demonstrate effective path following capability with minimal steady-state error and good stability. This research is relevant to Industrial Engineering applications in manufacturing logistics and warehouse automation. IEEE citation style. English language.
